category: Purview, DLP & data security for Copilot
title: Use Restricted SharePoint Search as a temporary guardrail
problem: You need to deploy Copilot now but haven't finished cleaning up permissions.
steps: Plan the permission cleanup — this is a stopgap (max 100 sites).
pitfalls: RETIRED: Restricted SharePoint Search is retiring — new enablement has been blocked since 31 July 2026. Use Restricted Content Discovery instead.
Users' own OneDrive and content they recently interacted with remain discoverable.
It is meant to be temporary, not a long-term control.
